name: Polynomial calibrations definitions
purpose: mcf defines polynomial calibrations, one record per definition, by giving up to five coefficients. SCOS-2000 computes the engineering value Y of a raw value X as Y = A0 + A1*X + A2*X^2 + A3*X^3 + A4*X^4, where A0 is MCF_POL1 and A4 is MCF_POL5. Unspecified higher-order coefficients default to 0, so a linear calibration needs only MCF_POL1 and MCF_POL2. Parameters use a polynomial calibration by naming it in PCF_CURTX or CUR_SELECT (numerical parameters, PCF_CATEG = 'N'). The engineering result is always real, which matters when several calibrations are attached to one parameter through cur, because they must all share the same engineering format. Polynomial identifiers share a name space with the other non-textual calibrations: an MCF_IDENT may not equal any CAF_NUMBR or LGF_IDENT. The ICD suggests a naming convention or a reserved range of names to guarantee this.

fields.name: MCF_IDENT
fields.description: Alphanumeric identifier that uniquely names the polynomial calibration; used in PCF_CURTX and CUR_SELECT. It must not overlap with CAF_NUMBR or LGF_IDENT values.

fields.name: MCF_DESCR
fields.description: Free textual description of the polynomial calibration.

fields.name: MCF_POL1
fields.description: Coefficient A0 (constant term), a numerical value in real format (Appendix A).

fields.name: MCF_POL2
fields.description: Coefficient A1 of the first-order term, in real format; defaults to 0.

fields.name: MCF_POL3
fields.description: Coefficient A2 of the second-order term, in real format; defaults to 0.

fields.name: MCF_POL4
fields.description: Coefficient A3 of the third-order term, in real format; defaults to 0.

fields.name: MCF_POL5
fields.description: Coefficient A4 of the fourth-order term, in real format; defaults to 0.

relationships.note: Shareable among parameters; must be unique across caf.CAF_NUMBR and lgf.LGF_IDENT.

history: ICD 5.1 calls the table 'Polynomial calibration curves: mcf' (p. 34-35); it has the same seven fields with MCF_IDENT as Number(4) and default '0' for MCF_POL2 to MCF_POL5. MCF_IDENT became Char(10) with the other calibration identifiers in ICD 6.0 (ICD 7.0 Annex 1, p. 247). Unchanged in ICD 6.7 Draft A (p. 66-67), 6.9 (p. 69-70) and 7.0 (p. 70-71). pyscos2000 (ICD 7.2) matches, including the '0' defaults.
notes: No discrepancy between ICD 7.0 and pyscos2000. Solar Orbiter 2025-09-16: 229 polynomial calibrations. Every record fills all five coefficients explicitly; 226 are linear (only A0 and A1 non-zero) and 3 use higher orders, e.g. CIAP0081TM 'DPU_TMP' (A0 = 180.65, A1 = -0.4018, A2 = 0.0003508, A3 = -0.0000001434, A4 = 0.000000000021, real data). Coefficients are written in fixed or scientific notation (e.g. 7.35043E-4). No MCF_IDENT collides with a CAF_NUMBR; 3 definitions are not referenced by any parameter.
